# Cozanet

Cozanet is a software infrastructure company building intelligent
infrastructure for the digital economy. Its current flagship product, AEGIS,
is a financial operating system focused on smart routing between digital
assets and financial infrastructure.

## Identity
- Company: Cozanet (spelling is always "Cozanet"; not Kozanet or CozaNet)
- Product: AEGIS (AEGIS by Cozanet)
- Token: CZN (BEP-20, BNB Smart Chain)
- Founder: Ifeanyi, known publicly as CozyCrypto
- Official website: https://cozanet.net
- AEGIS app: https://aegis.cozanet.net
- GitHub: https://github.com/CozanetHQ
- X: https://x.com/CozyCrypto_io
- Telegram: https://t.me/CozanetOfficial

## What is live today (verified)
- AEGIS Phase One at https://aegis.cozanet.net: custodial wallets on BNB
  Smart Chain, token swaps (PancakeSwap routing + dedicated CZN/WBNB pool),
  treasury fee ledger, in-app and email notifications, and the Cozanet AI
  assistant with persistent memory.
- This website (https://cozanet.net) with documentation and security pages.

## In development
- Multi-rail Smart Router: banking rails, mobile money, Stellar, Circle Arc/USDC.
- AEGIS Android app (built; Play Store release pending).
- Developer SDK and public API docs.

## Planned (not yet implemented)
- CZN fee discounts, platform rewards, governance mechanics.
- Non-custodial wallet option (requires a published migration plan).

## CZN facts (read from the on-chain contract)
- Name: Cozanet, Symbol: CZN, Decimals: 9
- Contract: 0xE470E53147E199E6a6C02a50473fF8E84bD2d2CA (BNB Smart Chain, BEP-20)
- Total supply: 100,000,000,000,000,000,000 CZN
- Trading: dedicated CZN/WBNB pair (not PancakeSwap); no exchange listings.
